# Version 4.151.0
> **Faster raster and text paths** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores faster CPU image rendering and reduces overhead in color and text hot paths. The Skia m151 release also adds span-based parsing and .NET 11 WebAssembly archives. Existing .NET 8-10 WebAssembly toolchain mappings are retained.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remove whitespace immediately after the color prefix** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse now reject whitespace directly after # in six- and eight-digit forms, matching the stricter short forms. Remove that internal whitespace before parsing; surrounding whitespace and case-insensitive hexadecimal input remain supported. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m151** — Updates the bundled renderer from m150 to m151 without changing the C API in the milestone sync. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Parse colors and four-byte tags from spans** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing for SKColor and SKFourByteTag, allowing slices of larger buffers without allocating substrings. The tag parser preserves padding, truncation, and low-byte packing semantics. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU scaled and tiled images regain their fast path** — Restores the legacy shader-context raster path for scaled or tiled bitmap draws, addressing high CPU usage and frame drops. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **GPU text and stencil reliability** — Fixes corrupt GPU text teardown, stencil-clear coordinate tracking and preservation, and dirty-state recovery when a resolve task fails to execute. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower-overhead color conversions** — Single-value SKColor-to-SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions avoid native round trips while preserving exact results. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Less temporary storage for shaped text** — SKShaper reads glyph results through spans rather than intermediate array copies, while HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) pools its encoding storage instead of allocating an array per call. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376))
- **Subset decoding releases intermediate images** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) deterministically disposes the full decoded image when Subset returns a different instance, while preserving same-instance returns. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **Matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 native libraries and the new exception-handling instructions required by .NET 11 preview 6 and later in this release. .NET 8 continues to use 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 use 3.1.56. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Buffer.AddUtf8(string) uses pooled encoding storage instead of allocating an array per call. Tag.Parse adds a span overload and removes its scratch array while preserving existing packing semantics.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 restored the faster CPU bitmap shader path, added matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and exception handling, and fixed subset-image resource retention.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 added span-based color and tag parsing, reduced shaping allocations, and fixed corrupt GPU text teardown. Color parsing no longer accepts whitespace directly after #.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)
